projects.name: Kochi - Fitness Coaching SaaS (Tradrly client project)
projects.status: Delivered to the client and used by coaches and their clients
projects.context: Client project at Tradrly for the Saudi market, team of 3-4 developers. Siwar's own work: 139 commits (backend, React Native app, Python data services).
projects.pitch: Arabic-first fitness coaching SaaS connecting coaches and their clients, with paid coaching packages.
projects.role: Owned the payment module and the AI migration, and built several full-stack features (announcements, withdrawals, Arabic validation UX).
highlights: Built the payment module end to end for paid coaching packages: card payments and Apple Pay via Tap, and buy-now-pay-later with Tamara and Tabby, covering checkout, in-app checkout screens, verification, capture, refunds and admin payment routes (Fastify/TypeScript backend + React Native/Expo app).
Secured payment webhooks with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification and constant-time comparison (timingSafeEqual); invalid signatures are rejected with 403.

Prevented double charges and duplicate side effects: an atomic capture claim (MongoDB findOneAndUpdate) stops the webhook and the app's polling from capturing the same Tabby payment twice; refunds use idempotency keys; late webhooks on terminal payments are ignored; a 409 blocks a second active subscription or a second payment in progress.

Implemented multi-currency pricing: 9 currencies with SAR conversion, an exchange-rate service with caching and a fallback to the last known rate when the provider fails, a price snapshot frozen into the training contract at payment time, a minimum price in SAR, a scheduled SAR price refresh guarded against overlapping runs, and a backfill script for existing packages.
Made the platform tax rate configurable with effective dates and conflict checks, applied to package payments.
Built coach earnings withdrawals (coach request flow and admin management) with MongoDB transactions to keep balances consistent and conflict checks against duplicate requests.

Migrated the AI features from Gemini/Groq to Anthropic Claude in the Node backend and the Python data services: chat topic classification, meal generation, food-plate photo analysis and InBody report OCR (Claude vision), with request timeouts, retries and defensive parsing of the model's JSON output.
Delivered an Arabic-first UX: backend validation errors normalized into Arabic and field-level Arabic error feedback wired across the whole app, with global error toasts.
Built coach broadcast announcements full stack: API, coach history, an unread section on the client dashboard and opening announcements from notifications.

Implemented role-based navigation (coach vs client route guards, onboarding-state routing), coach availability and invite codes, Expo Web compatibility for native-only modules, and responsive screens aligned with the Figma designs.
Wrote 46 Vitest test cases covering payments (Tap, Tamara, Tabby), pricing, exchange rates and validation.
